provenance.note: Upper-bound sketch, not measured. Strata IQ3_XXS blocks are 98 bytes (2-byte aligned); the MMVQ path loads qs with 16-bit get_int_b2 reads and one 256-entry grid lookup per 4 weights (native_mmvq/iq_kernels source, Strata 0.1.40.3). Strata measured 2.3-4.7x kernel speedup from aligned loads on 210-byte Q6_K blocks (INTEL.md). Assumed expert-kernel share of a resident round ~0.38 (resident compute ~63% of the round per the lever audit, ~60% of that in routed-expert MMVQ). local_speedup 2.0 is an assumed result of a structure-of-arrays repack (qs plane 16-byte aligned, signs/scales plane separate; zero extra bytes). Share grows if RQ-18 removes the miss stream.
